raw_tokens.value: Masterpiece ~ Lullaby of Ember the Ancient
The Lullaby of Ember the Ancient
You can put powerful creatures to sleep with the power of your song.

When you activate this soothing performance, one target within close range falls asleep as if affected by deep slumber (DC %1) as long as you maintain the performance. Unlike the spell (which affects weaker creatures first), this masterpiece targets a specific creature of your choice. Although this lullaby does have words, it is not a language-dependent effect.  Use: 1 bardic performance round per round.  Action: 1 round.|LullabyOfEmberTheAncientDC
